P1.1.text: ZoomInfo: The #1 GTM Platform - Sales AI for Lead Generation

P1.2.text: ZoomInfo is the #1 GTM Platform: Marketing and sales AI plus the best B2B data. All-in-one lead generation, prospecting, market intelligence, and ABM software.

P1.3.text: GTM starts with the best B2B data

P1.4.text: Power every stage of your GTM motion with clean, accurate, compliant, and actionable B2B data. Expand your total addressable market (TAM), prioritize high-fit accounts, and connect with decision-makers faster.

P1.5.text: Find your next best customers faster. Use firmographic, technographic, and intent data to uncover high-potential segments and prioritize outreach based on buying signals and revenue potential.

P1.6.text: Connect with the people who matter most. Access decision-makers, org charts, and real-time intent insights to personalize your outreach, boost response rates, and move deals forward, faster.

P1.7.text: Keep your funnel moving. Automatically route leads to the right reps based on account fit, territory, and buying stage. Sync enriched data to your CRM and trigger real-time follow-up workflows.

P1.8.text: “ ZoomInfo data drives 39% of pipeline and saves reps 11+ hours weekly. ” Seismic

P1.9.text: Grow, retain, and win more with every customer

P1.10.text: Use ZoomInfo’s AI-driven account intelligence to identify expansion opportunities, uncover new stakeholders, and remove friction from every stage of the deal cycle.

P1.11.text: Leverage AI to uncover strategic intelligence on your accounts - key decision-makers, org changes, pain points and usage trends - all in one view.

P1.12.text: Find new revenue paths by surfacing hidden stakeholders, uncovering multithreaded buying groups, and identifying whitespace within existing customers.

P1.13.text: Accelerate deals with AI-guided workflows that reduce manual effort. Equip your team with the context, content, and next-best actions needed to grow deals faster.

P1.14.text: “ ZoomInfo helped grow revenue by 300% in just one year. ” Zoom

P1.15.text: Maximize rep productivity with clean data and smart automation

P1.16.text: Drive more pipeline with less manual work. ZoomInfo helps you enrich data at scale, automate sales processes, and prioritize high-value opportunities - so your reps can spend more time selling.

P1.17.text: Automatically enrich and cleanse contact and company records across your tech stack - not just your CRM. Keep your data accurate, up-to-date, and always sales-ready.

P1.18.text: Build smarter territories using real-time firmographic and intent signals. Prioritize the right accounts in the right regions, and adjust quickly as markets shift.

P1.19.text: Use AI-powered scoring and buying signals to surface accounts most likely to convert. Focus reps on the deals that matter most - at the right time.

P1.20.text: “ Teams using ZoomInfo automate 30% more sales tasks. ” Salesloft

P1.21.text: Discover how ZoomInfo empowers revenue teams worldwide to grow faster at scale

P1.22.text: ZoomInfo is an all-in-one AI GTM Platform that helps B2B sales, marketing, RevOps, and customer success teams find, win, and grow business. It combines verified data on 500M+ contacts and 100M+ companies with the GTM Context Graph, AI agents that act on it, and access from any tool your team already uses. ZoomInfo was is headquartered in Vancouver, Washington, and trades on Nasdaq as GTM.

P1.23.text: Sales, marketing, RevOps, customer success, and recruiting teams use ZoomInfo, along with developers building AI agents. Customers range from fast-growing startups to 8 of the 10 largest companies in the world and more than half of the Fortune 500.

P1.24.text: Free to start with consumption credits based on usage. ZoomInfo doesn't charge by fixed seat tiers: teams pay for the credits they use, so cost scales with how much data and how many workflows they run. ZoomInfo Lite is a permanent free plan with no credit card required. See ZoomInfo pricing for current details.

P1.25.text: Yes. ZoomInfo Lite is a permanent free plan that requires no credit card and no commitment, and you can start a free trial of the full platform. Developers
